notes.title: Patch notes for Pleh! V1.7.0
notes.notes:
Thanks for the amazing response to the content update! Glad everyone enjoyed :)
By the way, if for whatever reason you can't access the update from the pause menu, you can always type "10.17" anywhere in the game, then head behind you and press the grey button on your left as an alternative to launching through the pause menu.


 Fixed a bug that showed the old 15cubes.zip instead of the new 12cubes.zip in the developer console, making it impossible to get the other ending (no idea how that happened, weird)


Also remember to check out the Knight In Time teaser trailer in case you missed it: https://youtu.be/fW7uZ7W2YYk

Please post any bugs or issues in the discord server and enjoy!

notes.title: Patch notes for Pleh! V1.6.9
notes.notes:
This is it, this is the update you've all been waiting for.


 CONTENT UPDATE: A non-cannon, 10-minute segment has been added to the game.  To play it, pause the game and press the "New Content!!!" button. You must have already beaten the game to unlock this. Please enjoy :)
 Fixed a bug in the house section that would black-screen the game.
 Fixed a bug that allowed you to interact with objects while paused.
 Pausing the game now hides the cursor to make the pause menu not as confusing.
 Added a link to Pleh! 3 in the dev room.
 Small performance updates, nothing major.
 Updated the end credits and credits PDF.


I've been working on this content update for the past month, it was really fun to come back to Pleh! after a few months and properly work on this game again. Aside from fixing bugs from this content update, there won't be any more major updates to this game. We're still working hard on Project Miles and have something to show in the very near future ;)

Thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for playing Pleh! 

What a wild ride it's been.

Please post any bugs or issues in the discord server and enjoy!

notes.title: Patch notes for Pleh! V1.6.8
notes.notes:
The chair in the [spoiler]10.17 room[/spoiler] now gives you twice as many hits, making it easier to get the 1500 achievement


That's all for Pleh!, but please note that we're still working on Project Miles and might possibly have something to showcase soon :D

Please post any bugs or issues in the discord server and enjoy!

notes.title: Patch notes for Pleh! V1.1.7
notes.notes:
Just some QOL improvements and a wholeeeee lot of audio stuff


 Made default volume quieter (this will only affect people launching the game for the first time)
 Made a few sfx softer (lightning, glitches, "pulses" ect)
 Fixed a bug where a few sections of the game weren't impacted by volume slider (lightning and watching videos in a developer console, if you somehow managed to ever gain access to that)
 Speaking of that, I lost a bet and my friend Benji made me write this here: "Hey guys it's me benji, I added an update to my program so now it scales with the screen size its rly cool haha check it out stay cool 😎"
 Made the 10.17 achievement significantly easier to get


Please post any bugs or issues in the discord server and enjoy!

notes.title: Patch notes for Pleh! V1.1
notes.notes:
Pleh! Update V1.1 is here!

First of all, thank you for an amazing launch! Glad to see everyone who has played the game so far really enjoy it! Here's a day-one patch:


 Fixed a few typos in both transcripts and in-game
 Added volume scale in pause menu


Yup, that's it! Hopefully we'll have some bigger patch notes in future updates, please post any bugs or issues in the discord server and enjoy!
